When Marvin left behind a violent life to hide in suburban Milwaukee as a mild-mannered realtor, he also left his former partner in crime, Rose. Now she's back and wants Marvin to help take revenge against his crime lord brother, Knuckles. Like it or not, Marvin is pulled back into a wild world where he'll need his lethal fighting skills, wit, and heroism to survive and save the day.
